hero.caption: Father Thomas Mooney conducting mass for the 69th New York State Militia (69th New York Volunteer Infantry Regiment, later the 69th U.S. Regiment) encamped at Fort Corcoran, Washington, D.C., June 1, 1861. Colonel Michael Corcoran stands at Fr. Mooney's right. Published in The Irish American, June 22, 1861. Photographed by Mathew B. Brady.
